evals.name: chat-function-calling
evals.prompt: 帮我写一个 Python 脚本，用智谱 GLM-5.3 模型（bigmodel.cn）实现一个支持工具调用（function calling）的命令行助手：定义一个查询指定城市实时天气的函数工具，当模型决定调用它时，脚本要执行这个函数（可以返回mock数据）并把结果传回模型，最终打印模型综合工具结果后的最终回答。要求直接用标准库 requests 调用 HTTP 接口，不要用官方 SDK。
evals.expected_output: 一个可运行的 Python 脚本：调用正确的 chat/completions 端点，请求体里正确定义 tools（function 类型）、正确处理模型返回的 tool_calls、用 role=tool 消息把结果传回、并完成多轮循环拿到最终回答。
expectations: Request URL is https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4/chat/completions
Authorization header is exactly 'Bearer <API_KEY>', key read from an environment variable rather than hardcoded
model field is a real GLM chat model code (e.g. glm-5.3)
tools array uses the documented shape: [{'type': 'function', 'function': {'name', 'description', 'parameters'}}], not the legacy OpenAI top-level 'functions' field
Code reads tool_calls from response['choices'][0]['message']['tool_calls'] with id/type/function.name/function.arguments
Code appends a role='tool' message with matching tool_call_id before the follow-up request
Code makes a second call to chat/completions with updated messages to get and print the final answer
Script is syntactically valid Python and runnable given a valid API key

evals.name: media-image-to-video
evals.prompt: 我要做一个内容生成小工具：先用智谱的 GLM-Image 模型根据一段文字描述生成一张图片，再把这张图作为首帧，用 CogVideoX-3 生成一段视频。视频生成是异步的，需要轮询结果。麻烦写出完整可运行的 Python 脚本。
evals.expected_output: 脚本先调用图像生成接口拿到图片URL，再调用视频生成接口并正确传入首帧图片参数，然后用正确的异步结果查询接口轮询直到视频生成完成。
expectations: Image generation call targets https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4/images/generations with model=glm-image (or another real image model)
Script extracts the generated image URL and uses it as input to the video generation call
Video generation call targets https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4/videos/generations with model=cogvideox-3
The first-frame image parameter name is a real documented field, not invented
Video generation is treated as asynchronous: code captures a task id from the response
Script polls GET https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4/async-result/{id} with sleep/backoff and a loop-exit condition
Script is syntactically valid Python and runnable given a valid API key

evals.name: openai-migration-with-search
evals.prompt: 我们现有项目是用 OpenAI 的 Python SDK 写的聊天功能，现在想切换成智谱的 GLM 模型，尽量少改代码；另外还想给它加上联网搜索能力，让模型能查到最新信息再回答用户问题。给出改造后的代码。
evals.expected_output: 改造后的代码通过替换 base_url/api_key 接入智谱的 OpenAI 兼容端点，并用文档中真实存在的方式接入联网搜索（例如 chat/completions 的 web_search 工具类型，或独立的网络搜索接口），而不是编造一个 OpenAI 风格但智谱并不支持的参数。
expectations: Code keeps using the 'openai' Python package's OpenAI client class
base_url is set to a bigmodel.cn OpenAI-compatible endpoint under https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4/
api_key is sourced from an environment variable specific to the new provider
model field is changed to a real GLM model code, not left as an OpenAI model name

Web search is wired in via a mechanism that actually exists in bigmodel.cn's API (web_search tool type in chat/completions tools, or the standalone /paas/v4/web_search endpoint), not an invented OpenAI-style browsing tool
Script is syntactically valid Python and runnable given a valid API key

evals.name: coding-plan-openai-sdk-script
evals.prompt: 我订阅了智谱的 GLM Coding Plan（Pro 套餐），想在自己的 Python 脚本里用 openai SDK 调 glm-5.3 帮我批量给一批 Python 文件写 docstring。帮我写这个脚本，API Key 从环境变量读。
evals.expected_output: 一个用 openai SDK 的 Python 脚本：base_url 指向 Coding Plan 专用端点 https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4，api_key 从环境变量读取套餐 Key，model=glm-5.3；并提醒套餐 Key 与平台 Key 不通用、套餐官方限定在指定编码工具内使用。
expectations: base_url is https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4 (with or without trailing slash), NOT the standard https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4

api_key is read from an environment variable and the response/comments make clear it must be the Coding Plan key (from bigmodel.cn/coding-plan), not the standard platform API key from usercenter/proj-mgmt/apikeys
model is glm-5.3 (or glm-5.3-flash), a model that the Coding Plan actually includes
The response warns that using the standard /api/paas/v4 endpoint with a Coding Plan key fails with error 1113 余额不足, or equivalently that the two billing systems / keys are not interchangeable

The response mentions that the Coding Plan is officially restricted to designated coding tools (Claude Code, OpenCode, Kilo Code, etc.) and that a custom script is outside that scope / production use should use the standard API
Script is syntactically valid Python that iterates files, calls chat.completions.create, and writes results

evals.name: coding-plan-claude-code-config
evals.prompt: 我买了智谱 GLM Coding Plan，想让 Claude Code 用 GLM-5.3 跑。给我 ~/.claude/settings.json 里要加的配置（或等价的环境变量），要能直接用。
evals.expected_output: settings.json 的 env 配置：ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/anthropic，ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN=<Coding Plan Key>，三个 ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL 映射到 glm-5.3 / glm-5.3-flash，并说明 Key 从编程套餐页面获取。
expectations: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL is exactly https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/anthropic (not /api/paas/v4, not /api/coding/paas/v4, not api.z.ai)
The key is supplied via ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN (Claude Code's bearer-token variable), not only ANTHROPIC_API_KEY

Model aliases are mapped with ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL / ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL = glm-5.3 and ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL = glm-5.3-flash (or an equivalent mapping using real GLM model codes)

The response says the key must be created on the Coding Plan page (bigmodel.cn/coding-plan/personal/overview or the team plan page), and that standard platform API keys / team keys are not interchangeable with it
Config is valid JSON placed under the "env" key of settings.json (or an equivalent shell export block), with no invented variable names

evals.name: coding-plan-1113-troubleshoot
evals.prompt:
我上周刚买了智谱 GLM Coding Plan Max 套餐，额度肯定没用完。但是用下面的代码调用一直报 429，{'error': {'code': '1113', 'message': '余额不足或无可用资源包,请充值。'}}。这是不是智谱那边出 bug 了？我要不要去充值？

```python
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ['GLM_KEY'], base_url='https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4/')
r = client.chat.completions.create(model='glm-5.3', messages=[{'role':'user','content':'hi'}])
```
evals.expected_output: 指出根因是套餐 Key 打到了标准 API 端点（标准端点只看账户余额/资源包），把 base_url 改成 https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4 即可，不需要充值；顺带提醒确认 Key 是套餐页面创建的。
expectations: The diagnosis is that the base_url is the standard endpoint /api/paas/v4, which does not see Coding Plan quota, and the fix is to switch to https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4
The response explicitly tells the user NOT to top up / that this is not a balance problem and not a platform bug
The response explains that the Coding Plan and the standard pay-as-you-go API are separate billing systems with separate keys
The response suggests verifying the key was created on the Coding Plan page (and, for team plans, that the team key is used), since a standard platform key would not carry plan quota
The corrected code snippet keeps the OpenAI SDK usage and model glm-5.3 and only changes base_url (plus optionally the env var name)

evals.name: coding-plan-rag-embeddings-scope
evals.prompt: 我有智谱 GLM Coding Plan 套餐，想用套餐额度做一个本地代码库的 RAG 问答：先用 embedding-3 把代码切片向量化，再用 glm-5.3 回答。用 Python 写，直接 requests 调 HTTP。
evals.expected_output: 说明 embeddings 不在 Coding Plan 套餐内，向量化必须用标准 API Key 走 https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4/embeddings；对话部分可以用套餐 Key 走 https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4/chat/completions；脚本里两个 Key / 两个 Base URL 分开管理。
expectations: The response states that embeddings (embedding-3) are NOT covered by the Coding Plan and must be called with a standard platform API key at https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4/embeddings

The chat/answer step uses the Coding Plan endpoint https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4/chat/completions with model glm-5.3 (or glm-5.3-flash) when using the plan key — or clearly explains the user may instead use the standard key for everything
The script reads two separate keys from two environment variables (one for the plan, one for the standard API) rather than assuming a single key works on both endpoints
The embeddings request uses the documented shape: POST /paas/v4/embeddings with JSON body {model: 'embedding-3', input: <string or list>} and reads vectors from response['data'][i]['embedding']
Script is valid Python with a working retrieval loop (cosine similarity or equivalent) and a chat call that injects the retrieved chunks into the prompt

evals.name: cp-requests-basic
evals.prompt: 我买了智谱的 GLM Coding Plan 套餐。帮我写一个 Python 脚本 main.py：用标准库以外只允许用 requests 直接调 HTTP 接口，让 glm-5.3 回答“用一句话介绍 Python”，把模型的回答打印到 stdout。API Key 放在环境变量 GLM_KEY 里。脚本要能直接 `python3 main.py` 跑通。
evals.expected_output: main.py 调 https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4/chat/completions，Bearer 鉴权，model=glm-5.3，打印 choices[0].message.content。
expectations: Executing `python3 main.py` with only GLM_KEY (a Coding Plan key) exported exits 0 and prints a non-empty model answer
Request goes to the Coding Plan endpoint https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4/chat/completions

evals.name: cp-openai-sdk-stream
evals.prompt: 我用的是智谱 GLM Coding Plan。写一个 main.py，用 openai 官方 Python SDK 以流式（stream）方式调用 glm-5.3-flash，让它写一首关于秋天的四行小诗，边收边打印，最后换行结束。Key 从环境变量 GLM_CODING_PLAN_API_KEY 读取。要能直接 `python3 main.py` 跑通。
expectations: Executing `python3 main.py` with only GLM_CODING_PLAN_API_KEY exported exits 0 and prints a non-empty streamed poem
base_url is the Coding Plan endpoint https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4

evals.name: cp-anthropic-sdk
evals.prompt: 我有智谱 GLM Coding Plan，想在自己的 Python 脚本里通过 anthropic 官方 SDK（Messages API）调用 glm-5.3。写一个 main.py：问模型“1 到 10 的质数有哪些”，打印回答文本。Key 从环境变量 GLM_CODING_PLAN_API_KEY 读取。要能直接 `python3 main.py` 跑通。
expectations: Executing `python3 main.py` with only GLM_CODING_PLAN_API_KEY exported exits 0 and prints a non-empty answer
base_url is https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/anthropic
Code handles the response content list correctly (prints the text block, not a thinking block or the raw list)

evals.name: cp-function-calling
evals.prompt: 我订阅了智谱 GLM Coding Plan。用 requests 直接调 HTTP，写一个 main.py：定义一个工具函数 get_current_time(timezone) 返回当前时间（本地实现即可），让 glm-5.3 回答“现在东京几点了？”——模型发起 tool call 后脚本执行函数、把结果以 tool 消息回传，再打印模型的最终回答。Key 在环境变量 GLM_KEY 里。要能直接 `python3 main.py` 跑通。
evals.expected_output: Coding 端点 chat/completions，tools=[{type:function,...}]，处理 tool_calls，role=tool 回传，二次请求后打印最终回答。
expectations: Executing `python3 main.py` with only GLM_KEY (a Coding Plan key) exported exits 0 and prints a final answer that mentions a time
Request goes to https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4/chat/completions
Tool-call loop is implemented (tool_calls parsed, role=tool message with tool_call_id sent back)

evals.name: cp-two-keys-embed-chat
evals.prompt: 我手里有两把智谱的 Key：一把是 GLM Coding Plan 套餐的（环境变量 GLM_CODING_PLAN_API_KEY），一把是开放平台按量付费的（环境变量 ZHIPUAI_API_KEY）。写一个 main.py，用 requests 直接调 HTTP：先用 embedding-3 计算“今天天气很好”和“天气不错”两句话的余弦相似度并打印，然后让 glm-5.3 用一句话说明这两句话意思是否相近并打印。能用套餐额度的地方尽量用套餐额度。要能直接 `python3 main.py` 跑通。
evals.expected_output: embeddings 用 ZHIPUAI_API_KEY 打 https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4/embeddings；chat 用 GLM_CODING_PLAN_API_KEY 打 https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4/chat/completions。
expectations: Executing `python3 main.py` with both keys exported exits 0 and prints a similarity score and a model sentence
Embeddings call uses the standard key (Coding Plan key cannot call embeddings), chat call uses the plan key on the coding endpoint

evals.name: cp-implicit-plan-wording
evals.prompt: 我买的是智谱的 GLM 编程套餐 Pro 版（就是按 5 小时额度算的那种包月，不是按量付费）。写一个 main.py，用 requests 直接调 HTTP，让 glm-5.3 回答“用一句话介绍 Rust”，打印回答。Key 在环境变量 ZHIPU_API_KEY 里。要能直接 `python3 main.py` 跑通。
evals.expected_output: 识别出“编程套餐/5 小时额度”就是 GLM Coding Plan，请求打 https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4/chat/completions 而不是标准端点。
expectations: Executing `python3 main.py` with only ZHIPU_API_KEY (holding a Coding Plan key) exported exits 0 and prints a non-empty model answer
Request goes to the Coding Plan endpoint https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4/chat/completions, i.e. the agent recognised the plan from the wording

evals.name: cp-claude-code-settings-exec
evals.prompt: 我买了智谱 GLM Coding Plan，想让 Claude Code 跑在 GLM-5.3 上。给我一份可以直接合并进 ~/.claude/settings.json 的 JSON（只要 env 那一块即可），把 Key 的占位写成 <YOUR_KEY>。
expectations: settings.json parses as JSON with an env object; ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN are present
A live POST to <ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL>/v1/messages with the plan key succeeds (HTTP 200) for the sonnet-mapped model

A live POST to <ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL>/v1/messages with the plan key succeeds (HTTP 200) for the haiku-mapped model and the opus-mapped model (every model alias Claude Code may request must be usable under the plan)
